name: Libram of Tenacity

description: Libram of Tenacity: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Thirty gold, traveler. Thirty gold and the required components.

clips.title: Completion
paras: It took Kariel what would amount to several of your lifetimes to complete the libram that you now hold, traveler. All for what? So that his disciple could stand in the Burning Steppes and bastardize his research in order to satiate a never ending arcane craving... Curse this foul addiction.
I am disgusted with your lack of compassion and insatiable greed. Be gone!
